items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Didn't you tell me that there was a lot of New Orleans musicians with the March of the Bobcat with Bob Crosby? Oh, I didn't know that.

ctx.x: How long have you been playing with Fuzzer?

How? Oh, God. I don't know Tony. I lost track. How long I don't know Tony. You mean how long I don't know Tony? Yeah. About 1970. I don't know Tony. About 1927. Did you play with him when you first met him? Yeah. Definitely. I've been playing with Tony for a half and half years, you know? We got on the house, you know? He called me a long ago. Right here. I was sleeping. And I talked, see? He called me. I want to talk to Sarah, you know? Mm-hmm. She said that he's sleeping. He said, well, it's more important to…
What about the Fern? What kind of numbers did you play at the Fern?
